proposals.evidence: DEDR5159 gives Tamil/Malayalam āṟu river with Tamil oblique āṟṟu-. These survey ārɨ/āru/āttɨ river responses are comparative simple-stem correspondences, retaining the rhotic/geminate and final-vowel transcriptions. Minority lects absent from the article are not presented as literal attestations; inheritance versus local transmission remains reviewable. Longer river-bank and large-river responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4892 directly gives Tamil/Malayalam mukil, Kannada mugil and Parji malgur cloud. Survey Irula mukilɨ and Kannada muyɨlɨ/muyulu are comparative final-vowel and medial-consonant variants; their complete transcriptions remain unchanged. Parji malgur is an exact dictionary match. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These matching cloud responses preserve length, stop/flap, gemination and final-vowel differences. Minority-lect extensions are comparative proposals, with inheritance versus local transmission pending review; longer rain-cloud compounds are excluded.
